connectorUiConfig.title: SOCRadar Alarms (Push, preview)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [SOCRadar](https://socradar.io) alarms connector lets the SOCRadar platform send your alarms to Microsoft Sentinel as they are raised or change. Nothing runs in your Azure subscription besides the data collection rule. Microsoft's CCF push connector is a preview feature.

sampleQueries.query:
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
 | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
 | sort by TimeGenerated desc
 | take 50

SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
 | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
 | summarize Alarms = count() by AlarmMainType
 | order by Alarms desc

dataTypes.name: SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
 | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
 | where isnotempty(Time)

value:

 | summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
 | project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(7d)

instructionSteps.title: 1. Create ARM Resources and Provide the Required Permissions
instructionSteps.description: This connector lets SOCRadar send alarms to Microsoft Sentinel through the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API.

parameters.content:
#### Automated Configuration and Secure Data Ingestion with Entra Application 
Clicking on "Deploy" will create the Log Analytics table and a Data Collection Rule (DCR). It will then create an Entra application, link the DCR to it, and set the entered secret in the application. This setup enables data to be sent securely to the DCR using an Entra token.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Values for the SOCRadar platform
instructionSteps.description: Use these values to configure the Microsoft Sentinel channel in SOCRadar.

parameters.label: Entra Application (Client) ID
parameters.placeholder: Deploy push connector to get the App Registration Application ID

parameters.label: Entra App Registration Secret
parameters.placeholder: Deploy push connector to get the App Registration Secret

parameters.label: Log Ingestion URL
parameters.placeholder: Deploy push connector to get the Data Collection Endpoint URI

instructionSteps.title: 3. Configure SOCRadar to send alarms
instructionSteps.description: The SOCRadar platform needs a Microsoft Sentinel channel. That channel is in development; until it is released, alarms can be sent with the sender script in the SOCRadar-Azure-Incidents-CCF repository (push/tools/send_alarms.py).

parameters.content: Send alarms as a JSON array to the Log Ingestion URL above, with an Entra token for the scope `https://monitor.azure.com/.default`. Add `company_id` to every alarm.

dataFlows.transformKql: source | extend AlarmText = substring(alarm_text, 0, 4000) | project-away alarm_text | extend TimeGenerated = now(), AlarmId = tostring(alarm_id), CompanyId = tostring(company_id), AlarmMainType = tostring(alarm_type_details.alarm_main_type), AlarmSubType = tostring(alarm_type_details.alarm_sub_type), Severity = alarm_risk_level, Status = status, Title = tostring(alarm_type_details.alarm_generic_title), AlarmDate = ["date"], AlarmPayload = pack_all() | project TimeGenerated, AlarmId, CompanyId, AlarmMainType, AlarmSubType, Severity, Status, Title, AlarmText, AlarmDate, AlarmPayload

resources.description: SOCRadar Alarms shows alarms by status, main type and severity, new alarms per day and the latest alarms.

properties.description: Raises one alert, and one incident, for every OPEN SOCRadar alarm of main type Executive Protection. Switch the rule off to stop incidents for that type.
properties.query:
let alerted = SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where AlertName startswith "[SOCRadar] #"
| extend AlertAlarmId = tostring(extract(@"#(\d+) ", 1, AlertName))
| distinct AlertAlarmId;
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| where ingestion_time() > ago(1h)
| where isnotempty(AlarmId)
| where AlarmId !in (alerted)
| where AlarmMainType == "Executive Protection"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
| where toupper(Status) == "OPEN"
| extend AlarmUrl = strcat("https://platform.socradar.com/company/", CompanyId, "/alarm/", AlarmId)
| extend SentinelSeverity = case(toupper(Severity) in ("CRITICAL", "HIGH"), "High", toupper(Severity) == "MEDIUM", "Medium", "Low")
| extend AlarmDescription = strcat(substring(AlarmText, 0, 1500), "\n\nSOCRadar severity: ", toupper(Severity))
| project TimeGenerated, AlarmId, CompanyId, Title, AlarmDescription, AlarmMainType, AlarmSubType, Severity, Status, AlarmDate, AlarmUrl, SentinelSeverity
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| take 149

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The SOCRadar alarms push solution for Microsoft Sentinel lets the SOCRadar platform send alarms to Microsoft Sentinel and raises one incident per OPEN alarm.

Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in Preview state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs.

  1. Codeless Connector Framework push connectors (preview)

  2. Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API

Data Connectors: 1, Workbooks: 1, Analytic Rules: 10
